subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Which remaining verified seam should be sponsored next, and which lower-priority rows should be deferred or removed from this tracker?
rationale: Source inspection confirms remaining duplication, but priority and permanent ownership across agent, gateway, session, provider, and plugin contracts require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sequence Verified Seams
options.body: Keep the tracker and sponsor one focused PR at a time, prioritizing demonstrated behavioral drift and session-state risk.

options.title: Narrow To Demonstrated Drift
options.body: Retain only rows with concrete behavioral or compatibility risk and remove type-only or speculative cleanup.

options.title: Pause Remaining Work
options.body: Treat the three merged rows as sufficient for now and wait for concrete regressions before further convergence.

recommendation.title: Sequence Verified Seams
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker and sponsor one focused PR at a time, prioritizing demonstrated behavioral drift and session-state risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this contributor to several central remaining ownership surfaces, making them the best available routing candidate for the sequencing decision.
